<a id="imo"></a>
### IMO

Intestinal Methanogen Overgrowth - the modern, more precise name for what used to be called "methane SIBO".

Used in
: [Read as one article: Overview: SIBO and SIFO]({{ "/en/sibo-sifo-overview-story.html" | relative_url }}), [SIBO markers: Methane (IMO)]({{ "/en/methane-imo-markers.html" | relative_url }}), [Stage 1 - biofilm disruption]({{ "/en/protocol-biofilm.html" | relative_url }}), [Stage 2 - eradication agents]({{ "/en/protocol-eradication.html" | relative_url }})

<a id="mmc"></a>
### MMC

Migrating Motor Complex - a wave of contractions that, between meals, sweeps leftover food and bacteria out of the small intestine.

Used in
: [Overview: SIBO and SIFO]({{ "/en/sibo-sifo-overview.html" | relative_url }}), [Read as one article: Overview: SIBO and SIFO]({{ "/en/sibo-sifo-overview-story.html" | relative_url }}), [Stage 4 - prokinetics]({{ "/en/protocol-prokinetics.html" | relative_url }})

<a id="sibo"></a>
### SIBO

Small Intestinal Bacterial Overgrowth - a condition where the small intestine hosts far more bacteria than normal.

Used in
: [Carbs, calories, and secondary lactose intolerance]({{ "/en/cascade-carb-calories.html" | relative_url }}), [Chronic fatigue]({{ "/en/cascade-fatigue.html" | relative_url }}), [Dosing schedule & course rules]({{ "/en/protocol-schedule.html" | relative_url }}), [Fat and fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K)]({{ "/en/cascade-fat-vitamins.html" | relative_url }}), [Overview: SIBO and SIFO]({{ "/en/sibo-sifo-overview.html" | relative_url }}), [Read as one article: Overview: SIBO and SIFO]({{ "/en/sibo-sifo-overview-story.html" | relative_url }}), [SIBO markers: Hydrogen sulfide (the third gas)]({{ "/en/h2s-sibo-markers.html" | relative_url }}), [SIBO markers: Hydrogen]({{ "/en/hydrogen-sibo-markers.html" | relative_url }}), [SIBO markers: Methane (IMO)]({{ "/en/methane-imo-markers.html" | relative_url }}), [SIFO markers: Fungal (Candida)]({{ "/en/sifo-candida-markers.html" | relative_url }}), [Self-observation: clear markers]({{ "/en/self-observation-markers.html" | relative_url }}), [Stage 1 - biofilm disruption]({{ "/en/protocol-biofilm.html" | relative_url }}), [Stage 2 - eradication agents]({{ "/en/protocol-eradication.html" | relative_url }}), [Stage 3 - binders & die-off]({{ "/en/protocol-binders.html" | relative_url }}), [Stage 4 - prokinetics]({{ "/en/protocol-prokinetics.html" | relative_url }}), [Stage 5 - mucosal healing]({{ "/en/protocol-healing.html" | relative_url }}), [Systemic consequences]({{ "/en/systemic-consequences.html" | relative_url }}), [Vitamin B12 and folate]({{ "/en/cascade-b12-folate.html" | relative_url }})

<a id="sifo"></a>
### SIFO

Small Intestinal Fungal Overgrowth - the same idea, but with fungi (usually Candida yeast) instead of bacteria.

Used in
: [Read as one article: Overview: SIBO and SIFO]({{ "/en/sibo-sifo-overview-story.html" | relative_url }}), [SIFO markers: Fungal (Candida)]({{ "/en/sifo-candida-markers.html" | relative_url }}), [Stage 2 - eradication agents]({{ "/en/protocol-eradication.html" | relative_url }})

<a id="auto-brewery-syndrome-term"></a>
### auto-brewery syndrome

A rare condition where gut yeast converts ingested carbohydrate into ethanol on the spot, causing intoxication without drinking alcohol.

Used in
: [Read as one article: Overview: SIBO and SIFO]({{ "/en/sibo-sifo-overview-story.html" | relative_url }}), [SIFO markers: Fungal (Candida)]({{ "/en/sifo-candida-markers.html" | relative_url }})

<a id="bile-deconjugation"></a>
### bile acid deconjugation

Bacteria chemically "unbuttoning" bile acids; in that form bile can no longer package fat into micelles for absorption.

<a id="biofilm"></a>
### biofilm

A community of microbial cells sheltered under a shared protective layer of polysaccharides - a city under one roof that keeps antimicrobials from reaching the cells inside.

Used in
: [Read as one article: Overview: SIBO and SIFO]({{ "/en/sibo-sifo-overview-story.html" | relative_url }}), [Stage 1 - biofilm disruption]({{ "/en/protocol-biofilm.html" | relative_url }}), [Systemic consequences]({{ "/en/systemic-consequences.html" | relative_url }})

<a id="dumping-syndrome-term"></a>
### dumping syndrome

A condition where food passes too quickly from the stomach into the intestine, causing a sudden fluid shift and hormone surge - sweating, a racing heart, dizziness.

Used in
: [Read as one article: Overview: SIBO and SIFO]({{ "/en/sibo-sifo-overview-story.html" | relative_url }}), [SIBO markers: Hydrogen]({{ "/en/hydrogen-sibo-markers.html" | relative_url }})

<a id="enterocytes"></a>
### enterocytes

The cells that make up the small intestine's lining and directly absorb nutrients from digested food.

Used in
: [Read as one article: Overview: SIBO and SIFO]({{ "/en/sibo-sifo-overview-story.html" | relative_url }})

<a id="methanogens"></a>
### methanogenic archaea

Microorganisms from a domain of life separate from bacteria, which produce methane using hydrogen as fuel.

Used in
: [Read as one article: Overview: SIBO and SIFO]({{ "/en/sibo-sifo-overview-story.html" | relative_url }}), [SIBO markers: Methane (IMO)]({{ "/en/methane-imo-markers.html" | relative_url }}), [Stage 2 - eradication agents]({{ "/en/protocol-eradication.html" | relative_url }})

<a id="supragastric-belching-term"></a>
### supragastric belching

Belching where air is sucked into the oesophagus and pushed straight back out without reaching the stomach or intestine - an oesophageal muscular pattern, not a digestive process.

Used in
: [Odorless belching - usually a different mechanism]({{ "/en/belching-differential.html" | relative_url }}), [Read as one article: Overview: SIBO and SIFO]({{ "/en/sibo-sifo-overview-story.html" | relative_url }})
